description: Use this when the user wants the contents of the original factory window sticker (Monroney label) for a 17-character VIN: total MSRP, base price, destination charge, every factory option and package with its price, exterior and interior colour, engine, transmission, fuel economy, standard equipment, the factory paint code and a link to the original sticker PDF (valid 1 hour). Needs a StickerByVIN API key on a Starter plan or above, sent as "Authorization: Bearer sbv_live_..." or as ?api_key= on the MCP URL. Each call counts as one API call against the key’s monthly quota. Returns an error when no original sticker is on file for the VIN; check_window_sticker tells you that for free.
name: get_original_sticker
title: Get the original window sticker (API key)
